Amakuru UMUSEKE wamenye, ndetse yemezwa n’ubuyobozi, hari abana bo ku ishuri ribanza mu murenge wa Munyaga, mu karere ka Rwamagana, bajyanywe kwa muganga bamerewe nabi, nyuma yo gukeka ko bariye ibiryo bihumanye.

Imboni ya UMUSEKE muri kariya gace yavuze ko abana benshi bajyanywe ku kigo nderabuzima cya Munyaga aho bakunda kwita ku ‘Gitaliyani’ bitewe n’uko hafashwa n’abagiraneza bakomoka mu Butaliyani.

Yatubwiye ko byabereye ku ishuri ribanza ryubatswe mu rwego rwo kongera ibyumba by’amashuri, mu mudugudu wa Gishike, Akagari ka Kaduha, mu murenge wa Munyaga.

Ati “Hari abanyeshuri bariye ibiryo bikekwa ko bihumanyije ndetse na bamwe mu barezi baje kurembamo benshi cyane.”

Hiyambajwe imbangukiragutabara ijyana abana ku kigo nderabuzima, abarembye cyane bajyanwa ku Bitaro bya Rwamagana.

Uyu waduhaye amakuru avuga ko abana bari bafite ibimenyetso byo gucika intege, kandi bari benshi kwa muganga kuko ibitanda ku kigo nderabuzima byari byabaye bikeya.

Igihe twahamagaraga umwe mu bayobozi kuri ririya shuri yatubwiye ko “amakuru atayazi kubera ko atakoze”, ariko ko agiye kubaza akaduha nomero y’umwe mu bakoze, byarangiriye aho.

Umwe mu babyeyi twavuganye ufite umwana urwariye mu Bitaro by’i Rwamagana, yatubwiye ko abana bajyeze kwa muganga mbere bahawe ubutabazi bw’ibanze.

Ati “Urebye mu cyumba turimo, ntabwo abana barembye cyane, dufite icyizere cyo gukira.”

Yavuze ko abana bamwe baribwaga mu nda, abandi bacibwamo, abandi baribwa umutwe hari n’abari bafite umuriro.

Mayaor w’Akarere ka Rwamagana, Mbonyumuvunyi Radjab yabwiye UMUSEKE ko kugeza ubu abana bameze neza, bavuwe.

Ati “Abana bavuwe bameze neza kugeza ubu, bishobora kuba ari nk’amazi banyoye y’imvura, ariko ubu bameze neza bari kubavura rwose bamwe banatashye n’abandi barataha, batatu ni bo bari buraremo bakazataha nk’ejo ntabwo ari ibintu bikomeye cyane.”

Nyuma y’iki gisubizo, umwe mu babyeyi bari mu Bitaro yavuze ko nta we barasezerera, kandi ko kuri “urgence” bakomeje kwakira abandi.

Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima (OMS/WHO) rivuga ko ku isi imfu zikomoka ku mafunguro ahumanye zibarirwa hagati ya 420,000 na 480,000 ku mwaka.

Abantu bagera kuri miliyoni 600 barwara buri mwaka, nibura umuntu 1 mu bantu 10 ni ukuvuga (10%) uburwayi bwe abuterwa no kurya ibiribwa byanduye.

Abana bari munsi y’imyaka 5 bakunze gukorwaho n’iki kibazo kuko hafi 30% by’imfu ni ukuvuga 125,000 by’abantu bose bapfa bazize indwara zikomoka ku biribwa byanduye baba ari abana bo muri kiriya kigero cy’imyaka.

Ikaze mu kiganiro c'imvo n'imvano co kuri uyu wa gatandatu igenekerezo rya 24 ukwezi kwa cumi mu 2026.

Mu kiganiro c'uyu musi tugaruka kw'ishigwa ry'urunani rwa politike na gisirikare FRN rurongowe n'uwahoze ari prezida w'igihugu ca Republika ya Demorasi ya Congo, Joseph Kabila, yagiye ahabona ngo arwanye reta y'ico gihugu.

Kuva urwo runani rutangajwe, haraciye hafi indwi zibiri, havuzwe vyinshi bitandukanye.

FRN ivuga ko ifise ihangiro yo gusenyura intwaro ya prezida Felix Tshisekedi hakoreshejwe uburyo bwose, harimwo gukoresha inguvu hamwe na politike.

Hari bamwe mu baturuka mu buseruko bwa Congo, ahasanzwe hariko harabera intambara muri iki gihe, bashima kuba Prezida Joseph Kabira ari we agiye kurongora urugamba rwatanguye ari urwo kugwanya amabi bivugwa ko akorerwa Abanye-Congo bo mu bwoko bw'abatutsi n'abavuga ururimi rw'ikinyarwanda.

Ariko hari abavuga ko uwo yahoze ari umukuru w'igihugu ca Congo, reta yiwe yagize uruhara mu mabi bakorewe aho mu buseruko bw'ico gihugu, mu myaka 18 yamaze ku butegetsi, ko rero bigoye gutahura ubu ingene yoza kubagwanira.

Itangazo rishiraho urwo runani rwa FRN ryo rivuga ko umuhari wa AFC/M23 wahora urwana urwo ugamba ubu utakibaho. Abahora ari abategetsi barwo bahawe amabanga ahambaye muri urwo runani rushasha.

FRN ivuga ko ifise ihangiro yo gusenyura intwaro ya prezida Felix Tshisekedi.

Inyuma y'ikiganiro ku ndwi iheze n'abihweza ibintu n'ibindi muri politike ku co babona ishingwa ry'urwo runani rushasha rishobora guhindura mu ntambara iriko irabera mu buseruko bwa Congo, hari benshi batanze ivyiyumviro bitandukanye ku mbuga zacu, bamwe barushima abandi barwiyamiriza.

Uyu musi twashimye guha ijambo abo mu mpande zose kugira na bo bavuge aho bahagaze n'impamvu bashigikiye uruhande uru canke ruriya.

Muri iki kiganiro Cyriaque Muhawenayo, ari na we yakibateguriye, ari kumwe na Ngarura Patrick ari ku ruhande rw'abadashigikiye urunani FRN n'umukuru warwo prezida Joseph Kabira, Patrick Makombe ari ku ruhande rw'abashigikiye urunani FRN, aba bompi bakaba ari abanyamurenge. Uwundi ni Dr Joseph Sebarenzi yigisha muri kaminuza ya School for International Training muri Reta zunze Ubumwe za Amerika.

Nicolas Jackson's double to defeat Manchester City on Saturday capped an excellent start to the striker's spell at Aston Villa .

Signed from Chelsea as a direct replacement for Ollie Watkins - Villa's main source of goals for the previous six seasons - it was imperative the 25-year-old Senegal international hit the ground running in claret and blue.

Jackson has done just that, scoring seven goals in his first 11 appearances for Villa - six in the last six - and helping his new side to a 100% start in the Champions League and spearheading their recovery after a slow start to the Premier League campaign.

"The players, the manager, the team - everything is incredible," Jackson told BBC Match of the Day.

"I'm very happy that I'm here and hopefully we can do amazing things together."

Jackson spent two full seasons at Chelsea after joining in 2023 and had a year on loan at German giants Bayern Munich before moving to Villa in the summer for a deal worth up to £65m.

There is a much smaller sample size from his time at Villa Park compared with his spell at Stamford Bridge, but on several metrics, he is showing signs of improvement.

Jackson scored 24 goals in 65 Premier League appearances for Chelsea , netting every 210 minutes on average, with a shot conversion rate of 15%.

That compares with four in seven games for Villa, averaging a goal every 138 minutes with a shot conversion rate of 21%.

One of the criticisms of Jackson at Chelsea was he had lots of chances and did not convert as many of them as he should.

In his early weeks at Villa, he is outperforming his expected goals tally by exactly two.

Both of their shots on target against City came from Jackson's right foot - and both ended up in the net.

'What a match' - Emery hails 'fantastic' Villa after they beat Manchester City

England international Watkins scored 91 Premier League goals in 221 league appearances for Villa before moving to Saudi Arabia club Al-Hilal in August.

He was a consistent scorer, never failing to reach double figures for Premier League goals during each of his six seasons with the club.

The respective statistics of Jackson and Watkins from last season suggest Jackson is more involved in general play than the England forward, while also being involved in more chances.

If Jackson's current run of form continues, his fee may prove to be a bargain.

Former Villa and England defender Martin Keown told BBC Sport: "I've liked him all season. I think he's key to Villa's success.

"I think he's an upgrade on Ollie Watkins, I really do.

"Ollie was magnificent for them, but this guy is more of a predator [in and around the penalty area]. Pace will always trouble top defenders and he's got it in abundance.

"I think having worked with the manager before at Villarreal, he's sort of fast-tracking his quick development.

"He looks like a really good piece of business right now. The team suffered and you need a striker who can give you belief you can win games when suffering and this guy is a special talent.

"With a talent like that you can go a long way."

Jackson double for Villa ends Man City's 100% start

Jackson spent an early part of his senior career playing under Unai Emery at Spanish club Villarreal

Saturday's win was achieved on the fourth anniversary of Emery's appointment as Villa boss.

Under the Spaniard, they have become fixtures in the upper echelons of the Premier League, regulars in European competition and ended a 30-year wait for a major trophy by winning the Europa League.

Results are one thing, but there are also numerous examples of players who have been rejuvenated or scaled new heights in their careers under Emery's management at Villa Park.

Former Scotland defender Rachel Corsie, who had a spell playing in the Women's Super League for Aston Villa late in her career, told BBC Radio 5 Live: "Emery is quite unique. A lot of coaches will focus on the tactical detail, but he's so intense with it.

"I remember from when I was here that his car is always at the training ground. I know people will say that's a natural thing and the life of a manager, but I would say it's an incredible amount of time.

"He loves to get the detail right. He never gets tired of trying to better people individually and that takes an incredible amount of work. So many players come here, improve and thrive."

Jackson has prior experience of playing under Emery, having been coached by him at Villarreal, where he spent three years before Chelsea signed him for £35m.

Emery told BBC Match of the Day: "I knew him at Villarreal and he started playing the level he is now. I know his capacity to exploit his qualities and I know, as well, his humility.

"The mentality is coming through - how focused he is in life and professional career."

Speaking to TNT Sports, Jackson added: "It's not easy [to settle at a new club] but easier because of the coach and the players.

"It's an incredible dressing room with an incredible manager. I'm very happy to be here and hopefully I will score many goals."
